unit: Algebra · Chapter 2. Statistics, combinatorics and probability
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The mean is the sum of the data over their number; the median is the middle of the ordered data and the mode the most frequent value.
stages.headlineEnglish: The mean is the sum of the data over their number; the median is the middle of the ordered data and the mode the most frequent value.

stages.headline: The range is the largest minus the smallest value; for an even number of data the median is the average of the two middle ones.
stages.headlineEnglish: The range is the largest minus the smallest value; for an even number of data the median is the average of the two middle ones.

stages.headline: The variance is the mean of the squared deviations from the mean M: D = ((x₁ − M)² + … + (xₙ − M)²)/n.
stages.headlineEnglish: The variance is the mean of the squared deviations from the mean M: D = ((x₁ − M)² + … + (xₙ − M)²)/n.
